model.schemabrain_demo.customer.name: customer
model.schemabrain_demo.customer.description: A registered shopper. Imported from the schemabrain_demo dbt project's `customer` model, which aliases the raw `public.users` table.

email.name: email
email.description: Login + contact email. UNIQUE in the raw schema.

model.schemabrain_demo.order.name: order
model.schemabrain_demo.order.description: A purchase placed by a customer. Imported from the dbt `order` model.

user_id.name: user_id
user_id.description: Customer who placed this order. Foreign key to `users.id`.

total_cents.name: total_cents
total_cents.description: Order total in minor currency units.

model.schemabrain_demo.product.name: product
model.schemabrain_demo.product.description: A purchasable item. Imported from the dbt `product` model.

metric.schemabrain_demo.daily_revenue.name: daily_revenue
metric.schemabrain_demo.daily_revenue.description: Sum of orders.total_cents grouped by day. Metric import lands in a follow-up release.

snapshot.schemabrain_demo.users_history.name: users_history
snapshot.schemabrain_demo.users_history.description: SCD-type-2 snapshot of users. Snapshot import is out of v1 scope.

seed.schemabrain_demo.country_codes.name: country_codes
seed.schemabrain_demo.country_codes.description: Static reference data. Seeds are static, not entities.
